# Indian Stock & Intraday Intelligence Terminal

> Handcrafted by Sahil. Real-time Indian equity and intraday telemetry terminal for NSE and BSE stocks.

## Overview
A high-performance stock analyzer and intraday trading workstation covering the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE). Designed with a strict zero-synthetic-data policy and verified financial feeds.

- **Author & Architect**: Sahil
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Emoxxe/stock-analyzer-intraday
- **Live Terminal**: https://stock-analyzer-intraday.vercel.app

## Features & Capabilities
- **Intraday Strategy Scanner**: Real-time detection of Opening Range Breakouts (ORB), VWAP Pullbacks, and RVOL volume spikes on the NIFTY 50 universe.
- **Interactive Candlestick Charts**: Canvas-accelerated financial charts powered by TradingView's Lightweight Charts v5.
- **Market Hours Engine**: Live tracking of official Indian market sessions (Pre-open, Regular trading, Post-close).
- **Fundamental Analysis**: Annual and quarterly financial statements, cash flows, and valuation ratios.
